El Financiero reports that several classic franchises will launch new titles before the end of 2025. 'Pokémon Legends: Z‑A' drops on 16 October 2025 for Switch 1/2, priced around 1,300 pesos. 'Keeper' arrives on 17 October 2025 for Windows and Xbox, free via Game Pass and on Steam. 'Call of Duty: Black Ops 7' is scheduled for 14 November 2025, available on Xbox Game Pass and priced 1,999 pesos, with a Steam pre‑order at $69.99 (~1,300 pesos). Additionally, NBA 2K26 will launch on 5 September 2025 and EA Sports FC 26 on 26 September 2025.

Title: Elon Musk promises to release "great" AI game by end of 2026

Summary: 
Elon Musk has promised to release a 'great' AI-generated video game by the end of 2026 through his AI studio xAI, reaffirming his intention after previously focusing on developing the X assistant Grok. In a social media post, Musk responded to a fan’s prediction that Grok would dynamically generate future video games, stating that xAI will deliver a 'great AI-generated game before the end of next year.' He also claimed Grok will produce a 'watchable' movie by the end of 2026 and 'really good movies' by 2027. xAI has been recruiting 'video game tutors' at up to $100 per day to train AI on game design, mechanics, and storytelling. Earlier in 2025, xAI successfully generated basic versions of Tetris and Bubble Trouble but struggled with retro sound effects. Musk has previously criticized corporate-owned game studios and expressed frustration with what he calls 'woke bullshit' in games, saying he wants video games to be left alone to preserve 'art.' He described gaming as his 'one recreational activity' and a way to 'quiet' his mind. However, Musk has faced criticism for allegedly faking gaming achievements and paying others to level up his in-game characters. Game developers, including the writer of Deus Ex and Avowed’s art director Matt Hansen, have mocked Musk’s complaints, calling his behavior 'deeply surreal' and 'the worst legacy' of the franchise. Meanwhile, OpenAI released an update to its Sora AI platform featuring AI-generated videos of Super Mario, The Legend of Zelda, and Pokémon characters, prompting Nintendo to threaten legal action and OpenAI to promise greater rights holder control. In unrelated news, the 2XKO anthem 'Ties That Bind' featuring Courtney LaPlante of Spiritbox was released.

Published date: October 07 2025, 10:44

Source: NME Music News, Reviews, Videos, Galleries, Tickets and Blogs | NME.COM
